summary: JinkoSolar Holding filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release in which its majority-owned subsidiary Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. (SSE: 688223) disclosed preliminary unaudited results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Estimated net loss attributable to Jiangxi Jinko shareholders is RMB2,976.33–3,576.33 million, with loss excluding extraordinary items of RMB3,811.12–4,411.12 million under PRC GAAP. JinkoSolar notes it owns approximately 54.32% of Jiangxi Jinko and cautions that subsidiary figures differ from its US GAAP consolidated results. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is involved; the disclosure is an ordinary earnings update with no special-situation mechanics or risk-arb angle.
